state.expectedPaperTitle: Effects of Cookie Banners on Consent
state.extractedText: Effects of Cookie Banners on Consent. We randomly assigned website visitors to two consent banner designs. The accept-all design increased consent by 12 percentage points. Our results demonstrate that cookie banner presentation affects user choice.
